subject: Q2 Kickoff: The Next Chapter
body: We've aligned on our strategy. Now it's time to execute. Quarter 2 will test our ability to stay focused while the market shifts.

subject: VIRAL SPIKE: We're trending on TechCrunch!
body: The blitzscaling is working! We're seeing massive traffic, but the servers are starting to smoke. Do we capitalize on the surge or cap the traffic?

subject: URGENT: Infrastructure Bill
body: Our AWS bill just tripled. If we don't optimize our instance usage, we'll run out of runway by next month.

subject: Refactor Request: Core API
body: Now that we're focusing on fortification, I want to take 2 weeks to refactor the core API. It'll slow down features but make the system bulletproof.

subject: CRISIS: Legacy System Crash
body: The legacy checkout system just died. Thankfully our fortification work saved the user data, but we need to decide how to recover.

subject: Pricing Update: Higher Tiers?
body: To hit our monetization goals, we should introduce a 'Platinum' tier for enterprise clients. It boosts AOV but might alienate our mid-market base.

subject: Enterprise Deal: Global Logistics Corp
body: A huge deal is on the table. They want a massive discount but guaranteed 100% uptime. This could double our revenue instantly.
